args.body: Hi Dora! I visited your personal website. It's clean and simple, and having your email front and center makes it easy to get in touch. It would be even better with more about you, such as your projects, interests or background, plus some visuals to give it more personality. Nice work!

Hi Eve! I enjoyed visiting your blog. Opening with your love of hiking gives it a personal feel. I'd love to see more posts about your favorite trails, with photos and tips, and a bit more structure, like categories or a post list, to make it easier to browse. Great start!

final_text:
